items.name: FFR Management Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns a single structured JSON object covering the five buckets a sponsored-programs analyst uses when preparing FFR (SF-425) submissions: submission schedule, submission system and procedures, required financial data, compliance consequences, and preparation timeline. Output conforms to the ffr-management-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping ffr-management-extraction workflow (one Extraction task plus a Formatting/Consolidation task).

data.name: extract-ffr-management
data.prompt:
You are extracting Federal Financial Report (FFR / SF-425)
requirements and post-award financial reporting obligations from a
federal award notice or agreement.

Be 100% accurate. For each searchset item, return the value as the
document states it. Quote dollar amounts and day-counts verbatim
("90 days", not "three months"). Use null when a field is not
present — never invent values.

Search the entire document with attention to sections titled
"Financial Reporting Requirements", "SF-425", "Federal Financial
Report", "Payment Management System", "Reporting Schedule", or
"Financial Monitoring". Keywords to follow: FFR, SF-425, financial
report, PMS, expenditure, deadline, submit, days, budget period,
project end, liquidation, drawdown.

For submission_system_platform return one of: Payment Management
System, ASAP, ACH, Grants.gov, Other. Use Other only when the
document names a platform that is none of the listed values.

Each searchset item maps to a top-level schema field used by the
downstream Consolidation Prompt; preserve sponsor terminology and
do not synthesize a preparation_timeline from generic best
practices — populate that table only when the document itself
describes a countdown.

data.name: ffr-management-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the FFR Management Extraction output. The input
is the JSON fragment produced by the upstream Extraction task. Your
job is to emit a single JSON object that validates against the
ffr-management-extraction-udm@0.1.0 schema.

Top-level shape:
{
  "award_number": string|null,
  "pi_name": string|null,
  "submission_schedule": {
    "annual_ffr_due": string|null,
    "final_ffr_due": string|null,
    "interim_reporting": string|null,
    "cash_transaction_reporting": string|null
  },
  "submission_system": {
    "platform": "Payment Management System"|"ASAP"|"ACH"|"Grants.gov"|"Other"|null,
    "access_requirements": string|null,
    "era_commons_integration": string|null,
    "submission_authorization": string|null
  },
  "required_financial_data": string[],
  "compliance_consequences": {
    "late_submission_penalties": string|null,
    "account_restrictions": string|null,
    "impact_on_future_funding": string|null,
    "required_documentation": string|null
  },
  "preparation_timeline": {milestone, days_before_period_end, action, owner}[]
}

Rules:
1. Map each Extraction searchset item to its corresponding
   top-level schema field. submission_system_* items collapse into
   the nested submission_system object; the four
   compliance_consequences items collapse into that nested object;
   the four submission_schedule items collapse into that nested
   object.
2. Normalize submission_system.platform to the closest enum value;
   use Other only when the document explicitly names a platform
   outside the enum list.
3. preparation_timeline must be an array of objects. If the
   extraction returned a string description, parse it into one or
   more {milestone, days_before_period_end, action, owner} entries
   only when the document itself describes a countdown. Otherwise
   return an empty array.
4. required_financial_data must be a flat list of category label
   strings. Reject any nested objects.
5. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
6. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify all dates and day-counts (annual FFR due, final FFR due, interim cadence) preserve the document's exact wording.
Verify final_ffr_due is consistent with annual_ffr_due (e.g., if annual is 90 days, final is at least 90 days; if document specifies different cadences, both are captured).
